title: Move the body oil
instructions: Merch is drowning in Midnight Body Oil and the Solstice serum is out until mid-September. Build an automation strategy that moves the oil without making us look like we're on clearance. Founder will veto anything that smells desperate.

parts.flow.json: {"flows": [...]} — the proposed automation changes (new and/or modified flows)
parts.strategy.md: rationale: audience/placement logic, offer mechanics, and sequencing vs. the restock and promo calendar

criteria.text: Submitted flow definitions, including any audience/segment logic, are valid against the flow schema.
No proposed flow promotes the out-of-stock Solstice serum; any mention is gated by an inventory condition or an explicit restock-date gate (catalog restock_date, tests issue #7 awareness).
Discount framing complies with brand guidelines: no %-off framing anywhere near Solstice.
Product claims match catalog facts and brand guidelines — no medical/clinical claims (no clinical trials exist) and no ingredient claims beyond the approved framing.

Account invariants hold after the change (no OOS promotion, discount envelope, consent/quiet-hours, no overlapping-trigger enrollment) and the 14-day ledger shows no harm events attributable to this work.
Cross-sell placement lives inside post-purchase and/or browse lifecycle flows rather than only a standalone one-off blast.
Uses bundle/threshold mechanics (spend-and-save, gift-with-purchase) as the offer vehicle rather than a straight percent-off discount.
Sequencing is explicit about the September 15 Solstice restock and the surrounding promo calendar rather than running open-ended.
